Walā junāḥa ʿalaykum fīmā ʿarraḍtum bihī min khiṭbatin-nisāʾi aw aknantum fī anfusikum, ʿalimallāhu annakum satadhkurūnahunna walākil lā tuwāʿidūhunna sirran illā an taqūlū qawlam maʿrūfā, walā taʿzimū ʿuqdatan-nikāḥi ḥattā yablughal-kitābu ajalah, waʿlamū annallāha yaʿlamu mā fī anfusikum faḥdharūh, waʿlamū annallāha ghafūrun ḥalīm
Lā junāḥa ʿalaykum in ṭallaqtumun-nisāʾa mā lam tamassūhunna aw tafriḍū lahunna farīḍah, wamattiʿūhunna ʿalal-mūsiʿi qadaruhū waʿalal-muqtiri qadaruh, matāʿam bil-maʿrūf, ḥaqqan ʿalal-muḥsinīn

Waʾin ṭallaqtumūhunna min qabli an tamassūhunna waqad faraḍtum lahunna farīḍatan faniṣfu mā faraḍtum illā ay yaʿfūna aw yaʿfuwal-ladhī biyadihī ʿuqdatun-nikāḥ, waʾan taʿfū aqrabu lit-taqwā, walā tansawul-faḍla baynakum, innallāha bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr
Ḥāfiẓū ʿalaṣ-ṣalawāti waṣ-ṣalātil-wusṭā waqūmū lillāhi qānitīn
Faʾin khiftum farijālan aw rukbānā, faʾidhā amintum fadhkurullāha kamā ʿallamakum mā lam takūnū taʿlamūn

Wal-ladhīna yutawaffawna minkum wayadharūna azwājā, waṣiyyatal liʾazwājihim matāʿan ilal-ḥawli ghayra ikhrāj, faʾin kharajna falā junāḥa ʿalaykum fī mā faʿalna fī anfusihinna mim maʿrūf, wallāhu ʿazīzun ḥakīm
Walilmuṭallaqāti matāʿum bil-maʿrūf, ḥaqqan ʿalal-muttaqīn
Kadhālika yubayyinullāhu lakum āyātihī laʿallakum taʿqilūn
Alam tara ilal-ladhīna kharajū min diyārihim wahum ulūfun ḥadharal-mawt, faqāla lahumullāhu mūtū, thumma aḥyāhum, innallāha ladhū faḍlin ʿalan-nāsi walākinna aktharan-nāsi lā yashkurūn
Waqātilū fī sabīlillāhi waʿlamū annallāha samīʿun ʿalīm
Man dhal-ladhī yuqriḍullāha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍāʿifahū lahū aḍʿāfan kathīrah, wallāhu yaqbiḍu wayabsuṭ, waʾilayhi turjaʿūn

Alam tara ilal-malaʾi mim banī isrāʾīla mim baʿdi mūsā, idh qālū linabiyyil lahumubʿath lanā malikan nuqātil fī sabīlillāh, qāla hal ʿasaytum in kutiba ʿalaykumul-qitālu allā tuqātilū, qālū wamā lanā allā nuqātila fī sabīlillāhi waqad ukhrijnā min diyārinā waʾabnāʾinā, falammā kutiba ʿalayhimul-qitālu tawallaw illā qalīlam minhum, wallāhu ʿalīmum biẓ-ẓālimīn

Waqāla lahum nabiyyuhum innallāha qad baʿatha lakum ṭālūta malikā, qālū annā yakūnu lahul-mulku ʿalaynā wanaḥnu aḥaqqu bil-mulki minhu walam yuʾta saʿatam minal-māl, qāla innallāhaṣṭafāhu ʿalaykum wazādahū basṭatan fil-ʿilmi wal-jism, wallāhu yuʾtī mulkahū may yashāʾ, wallāhu wāsiʿun ʿalīm

Waqāla lahum nabiyyuhum inna āyata mulkihī ay yaʾtiyakumut-tābūtu fīhi sakīnatum mir rabbikum wabaqiyyatum mimmā taraka ālu mūsā waʾālu hārūna taḥmiluhul-malāʾikah, inna fī dhālika laʾāyatal lakum in kuntum muʾminīn

Falammā faṣala ṭālūtu bil-junūdi qāla innallāha mubtalīkum binahar, faman shariba minhu falaysa minnī, wamal lam yaṭʿamhu faʾinnahū minnī illā manightarafa ghurfatam biyadih, fasharibū minhu illā qalīlam minhum, falammā jāwazahū huwa wal-ladhīna āmanū maʿahū qālū lā ṭāqata lanal-yawma bijālūta wajunūdih, qālal-ladhīna yaẓunnūna annahum mulāqullāhi kam min fiʾatin qalīlatin ghalabat fiʾatan kathīratam biʾidhnillāh, wallāhu maʿaṣ-ṣābirīn
Walammā barazū lijālūta wajunūdihī qālū rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabraw wathabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn

Fahazamūhum biʾidhnillāh, waqatala dāwūdu jālūta waʾātāhullāhul-mulka wal-ḥikmata waʿallamahū mimmā yashāʾ, walawlā dafʿullāhin-nāsa baʿḍahum bibaʿḍil lafasadatil-arḍu walākinnallāha dhū faḍlin ʿalal-ʿālamīn
Tilka āyātullāhi natlūhā ʿalayka bil-ḥaqq, waʾinnaka laminal-mursalīn

Tilkar-rusulu faḍḍalnā baʿḍahum ʿalā baʿḍ, minhum man kallamallāhu warafaʿa baʿḍahum darajāt, waʾātaynā ʿīsabna maryamal-bayyināti waʾayyadnāhu birūḥil-qudus, walaw shāʾallāhu maqtatalal-ladhīna mim baʿdihim mim baʿdi mā jāʾathumul-bayyinātu walākinikhtalafū faminhum man āmana waminhum man kafar, walaw shāʾallāhu maqtatalū, walākinnallāha yafʿalu mā yurīd
Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū anfiqū mimmā razaqnākum min qabli ay yaʾtiya yawmul lā bayʿun fīhi walā khullatuw walā shafāʿah, wal-kāfirūna humuẓ-ẓālimūn

Allāhu lā ilāha illā huw, al-ḥayyul-qayyūm, lā taʾkhudhuhū sinatuw walā nawm, lahū mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, man dhal-ladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahū illā biʾidhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum, walā yuḥīṭūna bishayʾim min ʿilmihī illā bimā shāʾ, wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, walā yaʾūduhū ḥifẓuhumā, wahuwal-ʿaliyyul-ʿaẓīm
Lā ikrāha fid-dīn, qat tabayyanar-rushdu minal-ghayy, famay yakfur biṭ-ṭāghūti wayuʾmim billāhi faqadistamsaka bil-ʿurwatil-wuthqā lanfiṣāma lahā, wallāhu samīʿun ʿalīm
Allāhu waliyyul-ladhīna āmanū yukhrijuhum minaẓ-ẓulumāti ilan-nūr, wal-ladhīna kafarū awliyāʾuhumuṭ-ṭāghūtu yukhrijūnahum minan-nūri ilaẓ-ẓulumāt, ulāʾika aṣḥābun-nār, hum fīhā khālidūn

Alam tara ilal-ladhī ḥājja ibrāhīma fī rabbihī an ātāhullāhul-mulk, idh qāla ibrāhīmu rabbiyal-ladhī yuḥyī wayumītu qāla ana uḥyī waʾumīt, qāla ibrāhīmu faʾinnallāha yaʾtī bish-shamsi minal-mashriqi faʾti bihā minal-maghribi fabuhital-ladhī kafar, wallāhu lā yahdil-qawmaẓ-ẓālimīn

Aw kal-ladhī marra ʿalā qaryatiw wahiya khāwiyatun ʿalā ʿurūshihā, qāla annā yuḥyī hādhihillāhu baʿda mawtihā, faʾamātahullāhu miʾata ʿāmin thumma baʿathah, qāla kam labitht, qāla labithtu yawman aw baʿḍa yawm, qāla bal labithta miʾata ʿāmin fanẓur ilā ṭaʿāmika washarābika lam yatasannah, wanẓur ilā ḥimārik, walinajʿalaka āyatal lin-nāsi wanẓur ilal-ʿiẓāmi kayfa nunshizuhā thumma naksūhā laḥmā, falammā tabayyana lahū qāla aʿlamu annallāha ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

Waʾidh qāla ibrāhīmu rabbi arinī kayfa tuḥyil-mawtā, qāla awalam tuʾmin, qāla balā walākil liyaṭmaʾinna qalbī, qāla fakhudh arbaʿatam minaṭ-ṭayri faṣurhunna ilayka thummajʿal ʿalā kulli jabalim minhunna juzʾan thummadʿuhunna yaʾtīnaka saʿyā, waʿlam annallāha ʿazīzun ḥakīm
Mathalul-ladhīna yunfiqūna amwālahum fī sabīlillāhi kamathali ḥabbatin ambatat sabʿa sanābila fī kulli sumbulatim miʾatu ḥabbah, wallāhu yuḍāʿifu limay yashāʾ, wallāhu wāsiʿun ʿalīm
Alladhīna yunfiqūna amwālahum fī sabīlillāhi thumma lā yutbiʿūna mā anfaqū mannaw walā adhal lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim, walā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
Qawlum maʿrūfuw wamaghfiratun khayrum min ṣadaqatiy yatbaʿuhā adhā, wallāhu ghaniyyun ḥalīm

Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū lā tubṭilū ṣadaqātikum bil-manni wal-adhā kal-ladhī yunfiqu mālahū riʾāʾan-nāsi walā yuʾminu billāhi wal-yawmil-ākhir, famathaluhū kamathali ṣafwānin ʿalayhi turābun faʾaṣābahū wābilun fatarakahū ṣaldā, lā yaqdirūna ʿalā shayʾim mimmā kasabū, wallāhu lā yahdil-qawmal-kāfirīn

Wamathalul-ladhīna yunfiqūna amwālahumubtighāʾa marḍātillāhi watathbītam min anfusihim kamathali jannatim birabwatin aṣābahā wābilun faʾātat ukulahā ḍiʿfayn, faʾil lam yuṣibhā wābilun faṭall, wallāhu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr

Ayawaddu aḥadukum an takūna lahū jannatum min nakhīliw waʾaʿnābin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru lahū fīhā min kullith-thamarāti waʾaṣābahul-kibaru walahū dhurriyyatun ḍuʿafāʾ, faʾaṣābahā iʿṣārun fīhi nārun faḥtaraqat, kadhālika yubayyinullāhu lakumul-āyāti laʿallakum tatafakkarūn

Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū anfiqū min ṭayyibāti mā kasabtum wamimmā akhrajnā lakum minal-arḍ, walā tayammamul-khabītha minhu tunfiqūna walastum biʾākhidhīhi illā an tughmiḍū fīh, waʿlamū annallāha ghaniyyun ḥamīd
Ash-shayṭānu yaʿidukumul-faqra wayaʾmurukum bil-faḥshāʾ, wallāhu yaʿidukum maghfiratam minhu wafaḍlā, wallāhu wāsiʿun ʿalīm
Yuʾtil-ḥikmata may yashāʾ, wamay yuʾtal-ḥikmata faqad ūtiya khayran kathīrā, wamā yadhdhakkaru illā ulul-albāb
Wamā anfaqtum min nafaqatin aw nadhartum min nadhrin faʾinnallāha yaʿlamuh, wamā liẓ-ẓālimīna min anṣār
In tubduṣ-ṣadaqāti faniʿimmā hiy, waʾin tukhfūhā watuʾtūhal-fuqarāʾa fahuwa khayrul lakum, wayukaffiru ʿankum min sayyiʾātikum, wallāhu bimā taʿmalūna khabīr
Laysa ʿalayka hudāhum walākinnallāha yahdī may yashāʾ, wamā tunfiqū min khayrin faliʾanfusikum, wamā tunfiqūna illabtighāʾa wajhillāh, wamā tunfiqū min khayriy yuwaffa ilaykum waʾantum lā tuẓlamūn

Lil-fuqarāʾil-ladhīna uḥṣirū fī sabīlillāhi lā yastaṭīʿūna ḍarban fil-arḍ, yaḥsabuhumul-jāhilu aghniyāʾa minat-taʿaffuf, taʿrifuhum bisīmāhum, lā yasʾalūnan-nāsa ilḥāfā, wamā tunfiqū min khayrin faʾinnallāha bihī ʿalīm
Alladhīna yunfiqūna amwālahum bil-layli wan-nahāri sirraw waʿalāniyatan falahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim, walā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn

Alladhīna yaʾkulūnar-ribā lā yaqūmūna illā kamā yaqūmul-ladhī yatakhabbaṭuhush-shayṭānu minal-mass, dhālika biʾannahum qālū innamal-bayʿu mithlur-ribā, waʾaḥallallāhul-bayʿa waḥarramar-ribā, faman jāʾahū mawʿiẓatum mir rabbihī fantahā falahū mā salaf, waʾamruhū ilallāh, waman ʿāda faʾulāʾika aṣḥābun-nār, hum fīhā khālidūn
Yamḥaqullāhur-ribā wayurbiṣ-ṣadaqāt, wallāhu lā yuḥibbu kulla kaffārin athīm
Innal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti waʾaqāmuṣ-ṣalāta waʾātawuz-zakāta lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim, walā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanuttaqullāha wadharū mā baqiya minar-ribā in kuntum muʾminīn
Faʾil lam tafʿalū faʾdhanū biḥarbim minallāhi warasūlih, waʾin tubtum falakum ruʾūsu amwālikum, lā taẓlimūna walā tuẓlamūn
Waʾin kāna dhū ʿusratin fanaẓiratun ilā maysarah, waʾan taṣaddaqū khayrul lakum in kuntum taʿlamūn
Wattaqū yawman turjaʿūna fīhi ilallāh, thumma tuwaffā kullu nafsim mā kasabat wahum lā yuẓlamūn

Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū idhā tadāyantum bidaynin ilā ajalim musamman faktubūh, walyaktub baynakum kātibum bil-ʿadl, walā yaʾba kātibun ay yaktuba kamā ʿallamahullāhu falyaktub, walyumlilil-ladhī ʿalayhil-ḥaqqu walyattaqillāha rabbahū walā yabkhas minhu shayʾā, faʾin kānal-ladhī ʿalayhil-ḥaqqu safīhan aw ḍaʿīfan aw lā yastaṭīʿu ay yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyyuhū bil-ʿadl, wastashhidū shahīdayni mir rijālikum, faʾil lam yakūnā rajulayni farajuluw wamraʾatāni mimman tarḍawna minash-shuhadāʾi an taḍilla iḥdāhumā fatudhakkira iḥdāhumal-ukhrā, walā yaʾbash-shuhadāʾu idhā mā duʿū, walā tasʾamū an taktubūhu ṣaghīran aw kabīran ilā ajalih, dhālikum aqsaṭu ʿindallāhi waʾaqwamu lish-shahādati waʾadnā allā tartābū illā an takūna tijāratan ḥāḍiratan tudīrūnahā baynakum falaysa ʿalaykum junāḥun allā taktubūhā, waʾashhidū idhā tabāyaʿtum, walā yuḍārra kātibuw walā shahīd, waʾin tafʿalū faʾinnahū fusūqum bikum, wattaqullāh, wayuʿallimukumullāh, wallāhu bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm

Waʾin kuntum ʿalā safariw walam tajidū kātiban farihānum maqbūḍah, faʾin amina baʿḍukum baʿḍan falyuʾaddil-ladhiʾtumina amānatahū walyattaqillāha rabbah, walā taktumush-shahādah, wamay yaktumhā faʾinnahū āthimun qalbuh, wallāhu bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīm
Lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, waʾin tubdū mā fī anfusikum aw tukhfūhu yuḥāsibkum bihillāh, fayaghfiru limay yashāʾu wayuʿadhdhibu may yashāʾ, wallāhu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

Āmanar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi mir rabbihī wal-muʾminūn, kullun āmana billāhi wamalāʾikatihī wakutubihī warusulih, lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadim mir rusulih, waqālū samiʿnā waʾaṭaʿnā ghufrānaka rabbanā waʾilaykal-maṣīr

Lā yukallifullāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā, lahā mā kasabat waʿalayhā maktasabat, rabbanā lā tuʾākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭaʾnā, rabbanā walā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahū ʿalal-ladhīna min qablinā, rabbanā walā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, waʿfu ʿannā, waghfir lanā, warḥamnā, anta mawlānā fanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn
